subject: Mitochondrial mutations from past injuries quietly undermine your resilience
script: From Agewell Brief: Mitochondrial mutations from past injuries quietly undermine your resilience. A new study shows that transient injuries trigger persistent mtDNA mutations that impair energy metabolism and increase future kidney injury risk—but adenosine repletion may restore ATP via AK4. Transient injuries cause persistent mtDNA mutations that impair resilience. Read the full source-linked dispatch and primary study caveats at AgewellBrief.com.
